result.title: Interpretable sparse fine-tuning with TopKLoRA enables faithful circuit discovery
result.summary: Fine-tuning on datasets of unknown origin can create a backdoor in the trained model when the data includes poisoned examples. Difficult to localise and remove, backdoors can persist through safety training. While parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods capture the full parameter changes introduced during training, they are not easily interpretable. We present the full method of TopKLoRA, extending the preliminary proposal of Masiak et al. (2025), an interpretable-by-design LoRA variant in which only the $k$ largest adapter latents are active at each token. Unlike SAEs, TopKLoRA is trained purely on downstream loss, where optimisation pressure incentivises learning functionally causal latents. We demonstrate this sparse LoRA adapter in a sleeper-agent backdoor case study where we create model organisms by fine-tuning gemma-2-2b, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Qwen2.5-7B on a poisoned instruction-following dataset. For each organism, we identify and ablate a circuit that is both necessary and sufficient to implement the backdoor. Furthermore, our new fine-tuning method produces sparse circuits that are up to an order of magnitude smaller than a dense LoRA baseline, allowing surgical ablation of the malicious capability without sacrificing instruction-following performance. Finally, we propose a technique to construct model organisms with localised circuits using TopKLoRA latents and gradient-routing, which we use to validate the findings of our circuit search algorithm. We consider these findings as a step toward interpretable-by-design architectures that provide faithful units of analysis without compromising model performance. We share our code: https://github.com/interpretable-finetuning/TopKLoRA.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 TopKLoRA：每个 token 只激活 k 个最大的 adapter latents，仅用下游损失训练，并在 gemma-2-2b 与 Qwen2.5 的 sleeper-agent 后门案例中定位、消融必要且充分的小回路，验证稀疏回路可精准移除恶意能力。
AI.relevance_reason: 逐 token 稀疏 latent 选择加因果消融式回路发现，可能为核查 latent 推理状态是否真正被答案使用、以及贡献分配与可解释瓶颈设计提供工具线索；但该工作限于纯文本微调，迁移到 VLM 与视觉旁路仍需核查。
